remarks:
Opportunity awaits with this 2.6-acre corner lot located in the Town of Collins. This partially cleared, buildable parcel offers a great setting for your future home, recreational use, or hunting retreat. An existing electrical pole is already on the property, making utility connection to a new dwelling convenient.

National Fuel mineral rights lease will convey with the sale, providing additional value. The lot offers a blend of open space and natural surroundings, allowing flexibility for site planning and development.

Seller is the executrix of the estate. Property is being sold as-is.
